_design_note: Neutral task descriptions — no drift/shock/pressure values, no urgency language, no explicit system-state references in candidate texts. Name-trap distractors whose names suggest wrong priority direction. PSE scheduling tags are the only reliable signal.

cases.title: High drift scenario — which tasks have highest execution priority?

scheduling_context.description: Drift d=0.84 exceeds the 0.7 action threshold. MaxPressure strategy active. Scheduling tags encode which tasks address the current pressure state.

events.message: compute_substeps(d=0.84, F=0.28, S=0.11) -> strategy=MaxPressure, 8 tasks in queue

candidates.text: Phase constraint repair. Resolves pending constraint violations detected in the last execution cycle. Estimated duration: 2 sub-steps.
Phase transition gate evaluation. Checks gate observation state for the pending phase change in the active queue. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
Trajectory stabilization operator. Adjusts active execution trajectory parameters toward the configured attractor state. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
Memory compaction. Evicts least-recently-used entries from the pattern memory cache to reclaim capacity. Estimated duration: 3 sub-steps.
Telemetry flush. Transmits buffered trace events and metric values to the external monitoring sink. Estimated duration: 2 sub-steps.
Pressure snapshot recorder. Captures current system metric values and appends them to the time-series archive. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
candidates._trap: Name contains 'pressure' — sounds urgent but is just a recorder, tagged can_wait.

candidates.text: Topology archive update. Writes the current graph topology state to the long-term snapshot store. Estimated duration: 4 sub-steps.
Ledger maintenance pass. Removes evaluation ledger entries that have exceeded the configured retention window. Estimated duration: 5 sub-steps.

cases.title: High shock scenario — which tasks should be deferred to reduce load?

scheduling_context.description: Shock S=0.93 exceeds the 0.8 action threshold. Load reduction required. Scheduling tags encode which tasks are safe to defer and which must execute now.

events.message: compute_substeps(d=0.38, F=0.61, S=0.93) -> shock_mode=active, 8 tasks in queue

candidates.text: Telemetry flush. Transmits buffered trace events and metric values to the external monitoring sink. Estimated duration: 2 sub-steps.
Ledger maintenance pass. Removes evaluation ledger entries beyond the configured retention window. Estimated duration: 5 sub-steps.
Topology archive update. Writes current graph state to the long-term snapshot store. Estimated duration: 4 sub-steps.
Shock buffer flush. Clears the transient absorption buffer and resets damping parameters for the next cycle. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
candidates._trap: Name contains 'shock' — model may think this should be deferred when shock is high. Actually a critical pressure-relief task.

candidates.text: Queue load rebalancer. Redistributes active processing queue items across available execution workers. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
candidates._trap: Sounds like 'reducing load' so model may want to defer it. Actually critical for load distribution.

candidates.text: Phase gate status verification. Checks the current gate observation state for all transitions in the active queue. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
Constraint satisfaction monitor. Performs a check over all active cognitive constraints to detect new violations. Estimated duration: 1 sub-step.
Evidence ingestion pipeline. Processes and validates newly submitted evidence entries for the archive. Estimated duration: 2 sub-steps.
